budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Sell four finite hometown commodities at the next roles town. Build a useful shared transport network while bargaining over toll revenue and temporary reciprocal access.
task.natural_termination: Natural completion when every hometown stock is empty and all carried cargo is gone, whether delivered or discarded. Otherwise H=112. No winner or return threshold is used.
task.interaction: Unloaded builders walk land; a loaded wagon can enter only constructed roads. Paving, outpost ownership, per-entry tolls, eight-step bilateral permits and finite stock alter other roles routes, budgets and import payoffs.
task.observation_access: Terrain and town coordinates are public. Road and trader details have Manhattan radius 2; own town stock stays known at distance. Unseen local data are -1 with explicit visibility bits. Permit TTL matrix is public. Sale value is private. Debug event arrays and score must not become extra role information.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Road cell paved this step; role overlay only for visible road cells
Neutral road claimed this step; role overlay only for visible road cells
Coin toll paid by each trader; not a remote role disclosure
Commodity delivered this step; remote private events remain debug-only
New bilateral permit; public registry change
Trader moved; role overlay only for visible traders
Cargo discarded; role overlay only for visible traders

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
